name: document-platform
description: AppToolkitLab by Gonexel — document tools, SaaS workflows, and software marketplace

scripts.build: corepack pnpm db:generate && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:live:e2e: corepack pnpm test:integration && corepack pnpm test:baseline && corepack pnpm test:memory:e2e && corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api run test:queue-disabled:e2e
scripts.clean: corepack pnpm -r --if-present run clean && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio gotenberg
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop postgres redis minio gotenberg
scripts.node:setup: corepack pnpm --filter './packages/**' --if-present run build && corepack pnpm db:generate && corepack pnpm db:migrate && corepack pnpm db:seed
scripts.hostinger:build: DEPLOYMENT_MODE=HOSTINGER REDIS_ENABLED=false PROCESSING_NATIVE_ENABLED=false corepack pnpm node:build
scripts.hostinger:start: DEPLOYMENT_MODE=HOSTINGER REDIS_ENABLED=false PROCESSING_NATIVE_ENABLED=false corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @docconv/api --filter web run start
scripts.hybrid:setup: docker compose stop api worker web && corepack pnpm infra:up && corepack pnpm node:setup
scripts.hybrid:dev: docker compose stop api worker web && corepack pnpm infra:up && corepack pnpm node:setup && corepack pnpm node:dev
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api exec prisma db seed
scripts.blog-studio:verify: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/blog-engine test && corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api test && corepack pnpm --filter web test && corepack pnpm --filter web build
